description: Follow the links of a site from a start page, up to 60 pages: status, title, description, h1, word count and speed of every page, each broken link with the pages that carry it, duplicate and missing titles, and a ready sitemap.xml. Price: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..

checkExternal.description: Also check that links to other sites answer (up to 40 of them).

respectRobots.description: Leave out pages the site's robots.txt closes to crawlers.

url.description: Where to start. Only pages on the same host are followed.
